programs.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
programs.desc: Harry Potter begins his fourth year at the School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.The Triwizard Tournament is also approaching, with representatives of the three most prestigious universities taking part: Hogwarts, Beauxbatons and Durmstrang.The Goblet of Fire predicts the players.Harry Potter is also one of the lucky ones, even though he has not reached the required age.The young wizard's friends, Hermione and Ron, sense that there is some trick behind it.Regardless of the suspicions, the boy must face three competition tasks.In addition, he must also face his greatest enemy - Lord Voldemort.The fourth volume of the popular series of novels by J.K.Rowling was successfully brought to the screen by Mike Newell, the creator of the hits "Four Weddings and a Funeral" and "Donnie Brasco".The film received, among others:Oscar nomination for scenography.

programs.title: Materialists
programs.desc: Lucy (Dakota Johnson), an employee of a luxury dating agency, measures her professional success by having nine arranged marriages.Together with her colleagues, she recruits clients based on their market value, which is determined by financial status, education and age.She follows a similar logic herself.She ended her five-year relationship because her boyfriend John (Chris Evans) had too little income.Now she is single and waiting for a rich man whom she will quickly marry.Fate sends her Harry (Pedro Pascal), the owner of an apartment worth... 12 million dollars.A relationship with him, even without love, becomes a beneficial investment for her and a guarantee of a high standard of living.But then John appears on the horizon again and, against her better judgment, Lucy begins to have doubts...

programs.title: The Martian
programs.desc: A mission to the Red Planet is interrupted by a sandstorm.A team of astronauts evacuates to Earth, leaving one of the expedition members, Mark Watney (Matt Damon), on the surface of Mars, believing he is dead.After some time, the seriously injured astronaut regains consciousness.He realizes that his air and food supplies will soon be exhausted.He also cannot count on a rescue mission because he was presumed dead.Despite this, he tries to survive in difficult conditions and notify the inhabitants of Earth that he is alive and waiting for help.Ridley Scott's film is nominated for an Oscar in seven categories, including:as the best film and for the leading role of Matt Damon.Director Ridley Scott, the creator of such cult sci-fi films as "Blade Runner" and the Alien series, was a candidate for the Academy Award four times.

programs.title: Blue Valentine
programs.desc: Dean grew up in a broken home.He never planned to build a lasting relationship until he met Cindy, with whom he fell in love at first sight.When, after a few weeks of dating, it turns out that the girl is expecting another man's child, she makes the difficult decision to get married.The couple tries to create a happy family, but over time they begin to face a serious crisis.The infatuation disappears, and everyday problems make it difficult for them to find understanding.Dean abuses alcohol and does simple physical work, unable to guarantee his wife real stability and support.The couple falls into conflicts more and more often.However, he still tries to rebuild his relationships for the sake of little Frankie.This perfectly portrayed study of the breakdown of a relationship was nominated for the Grand Jury Prize at the Sundance Film Festival.The role of Michelle Williams was nominated for an Oscar and a Golden Globe.

programs.title: It's a Wonderful Knife
programs.desc: A year ago, teenage Winnie Carruthers (Jane Widdop) had to face a psychopathic murderer, Henry Waters (Justin Long), on Christmas Eve, whose victim was also her best friend.Now it's Christmas again in the town of Angel Falls.Winnie still remembers the tragic events, although her father David (Joel McHale) and other loved ones advise her to leave the difficult past behind.A misunderstood girl on a bridge on Christmas night makes a wish - she would prefer to have never been born.He then finds himself in a nightmarish parallel universe.He discovers that without her, everything could have turned out much worse.No one recognizes her here, she is a stranger even to her family and friends.And what's worse, Henry is still alive and the mayor of Angel Falls.The teenager must regain her former life and face a bloodthirsty murderer.A bloody variation on the famous Christmas classic - "It's a Wonderful Life" by Frank Capra.

programs.title: 4 from there
programs.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programs.title: House of the Dragon 2
programs.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

programs.title: Dope Girls
programs.desc: A widowed single mother, Kate is perceived by those around her as a calm person with conservative views.To provide for his family, he decides to take a surprising step - he opens a nightclub.

programs.title: The Doll
programs.desc: Rémi did not recover from the breakup.In order to function, he remains in a relationship with the doll Audrey, with whom he lives and shares everyday affairs.One day, a new colleague shows up at his company.

programs.title: Fault
programs.desc: Charismatic DJ Vika has always believed that age is a state of mind.She changed her approach when her health deteriorated.She realized that her goal could be to bring joy to other seniors.
